_doc: Shared PHP<->JS composition-validation contract (D5). Both pp_validate_composition (lib/admin.php) and validateCompositionData (assets/js/pp-editor-logic.js) MUST agree valid/invalid on every case here. If one validator drifts on a shared-contract rule, its test fails. Anchored on the real `hero` component (title required, subtitle optional) and the real template-owned chrome `nav`/`footer`, which both sides resolve: PHP via pp_get_registered_components() + pp_template_owned_components(), JS via the `registry` field below (the `templateOwned` flag mirrors what lib/admin.php localizes into ppAdminEditor.components).
_known_asymmetries: BLANK required prop: JS rejects a present-but-blank required prop ('' / null / false); PHP only checks presence (array_key_exists). Intentional — the client gives friendlier UX, the server treats blank as a provided value. NOT a shared-contract case; do not add blank-prop cases here.

STYLE slots: PHP additionally validates the optional `style` slot map + token values (injection guard); JS ignores `style`. Intentional — the server is authoritative on style-slot security. Covered by SchemaValidationTest's style-slot tests, not by this shared set.

cases.name: valid: hero with title + optional subtitle
invalid: hero with no props object at all
invalid: nav is template-owned chrome, not composable (#223)
invalid: footer is template-owned chrome, not composable (#223)
invalid: nav with no props object at all is still chrome (#223)
invalid: chrome rejected even alongside valid content (#223)
invalid: chrome rejected when it trails valid content (#223)
